brief: A seed-starting tray of at least four cells, each with a draining bin.

requirements.requirement: Seed-starting tray with at least four cells
requirements.evidence: 4 bases at -1,0,0 / 0,-1,0 / 0,0,0 / 0,1,0 providing four contiguous hex cells.

requirements.requirement: Each cell has a draining bin
requirements.evidence: bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,-1,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-drain – all 'drained' variant with drainage holes.

finish.summary: Built compact 4-cell tray (two+two cluster) with full-depth drained bins in every cell, filled with soil and planted with seedlings to demonstrate seed-starting use. Caps and joint bolts applied.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your seed-starting tray is on the bench — I'll get a four-cell drained layout built out.
